newsitem.title: PERU: RESEARCH ALERT- BARINGS REITERATES CREDICORP BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- BARINGS REITERATES CREDICORP BUY.

text.p: ING Barings said Monday it had reiterated its buy recommendation on Peru's leading financial services holding company Credicorp because of its strong second quarter operative earnings.
-- Barings, in a statement, told investors to "expect improvements in earnings for the second half of 1997 from higher loan growth and lower growth in expenses as (an) investment plan is finalized."
-- Barings also said five percent growth in the second quarter of 1997, compared with the same quarter last year, was "proof of the bank's good profitability profile."
